mapper.select: SELECT sp.id AS id, sp.story_id AS storyId, s.title AS storyTitle, s.user_id AS ownerUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.realname, ''), u.username) AS ownerDisplayName, sp.channel_code AS channelCode, c.channel_name AS channelName, sp.status AS status, sp.display_title AS displayTitle, sp.display_subtitle AS displaySubtitle, sp.cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, sp.intro_text AS introText, sp.sort_order AS sortOrder, sp.published_at AS publishedAt, sp.offline_at AS offlineAt, sp.reject_reason AS rejectReason, sp.ext_json AS extJson, sp.create_time AS createTime, sp.update_time AS updateTime FROM ts_story_public sp INNER JOIN ts_story_info s ON s.id = sp.story_id LEFT JOIN ts_public_channel c ON c.channel_code = sp.channel_code LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE sp.id = #{id} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status != 9) LIMIT 1
